ruleDefinitions.name: Powershell DNSExfiltration
ruleDefinitions.description: DNSExfiltrator allows for transferring (exfiltrate) a file over a DNS request covert channel Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-DNSExfiltrator.*") OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-i\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-d\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-p\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-doh\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-t\\ .*")))
